repo_meta_data.description: Portable memory for AI agents — the open MCP client for SAIHM. Eight tools any MCP agent uses to reach a SAIHM operator endpoint: encrypted, shareable, provably erased. Implements the publicly documented SAIHM memory protocol (Independent-Submission Internet-Draft; not an IETF standard). Evaluate it offline first with the runnable demos.
